views.title: 共阳数码管与 BCD 译码
views.last: 回到最初的 17，我现在会分别想到十位和个位的 BCD、被选中的段，以及经过每只 LED 的电流。若某一段始终不亮，可以沿那条支路找；若整位稳定显示成另一个数，就先对照输入位序和译码条件。一个小小的显示结果，终于能和具体引脚、具体电流对应起来了。以后再碰到数码管，我也更知道该从哪里开始看。

views.title: Common-Anode Displays and BCD Decoding
views.last: Returning to 17, I now think about the BCD code for each digit, the selected segments, and the current through each LED. A segment that never lights leads me along its individual branch; a whole digit that consistently shows the wrong number sends me first to input order and decoding conditions. The small display now connects to specific pins and currents. I have a much clearer starting point the next time I work with one.

views.title: 自锁按键与计数控制
views.last: 现在再看暂停和复位，我脑子里会先分清触点接到了哪里，电平什么时候稳定，以及哪一次变化该触发动作。最后还要给主循环留出及时处理它们的机会。把这些关系安排清楚以后，我才更有把握让开关按预期工作；遇到异常时，也知道该去检查接线、输入变化，还是计数程序。

views.title: Latching Switches and Counter Control
views.last: I now approach pause and reset by separating the contact connections, the point at which a level becomes stable, and the transition that should trigger an action. The loop also needs time to handle them promptly. With those relationships worked out, I have a better basis for making the switches behave as intended. If they do not, I know to examine the wiring, input changes, or counter program in turn.
